# widest_path_bottleneck_from_seed { #mofography.widest_path_resegment.widest_path_bottleneck_from_seed }

```python
widest_path_resegment.widest_path_bottleneck_from_seed(
    dgrid,
    mask,
    seed,
    offsets=None,
)
```

Max-bottleneck distances from ``seed`` on the void graph (26-NN).

``bottleneck[v] = max over paths seed→v of min(dgrid along path)``.
Unreachable voxels remain ``-1``.
